newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian spy satellites may soon be obsolete.
newsitem.headline: Russian spy satellites may soon be obsolete.

text.p: Russian military satellites, whose mission is to warn of possible nuclear rocket launches around the world, may soon become obsolete, an Air Defence spokeswoman said on Thursday.
She told Reuters that six of every 10 Russian satellites no longer had the resources to work normally in orbit.
"All the military satellites are still functioning but not at full strength," she said. The spokeswoman declined to say how many military satellites Russia had.
Last week the head of the Russian army's general staff Viktor Samsonov said that Russia did not have new satellites at present to replace outdated probes.
Defence Minister Igor Rodionov recently said Western spy satellites that observed Russian territory were constantly being upgraded.
